top_signals.title: Fuel Surcharge Gaps: What Carriers Miss on Every Load
top_signals.summary:
Fuel surcharge gaps are quietly killing carrier margins. Matt Cartwright of Magnus Technologies explains how fleets can measure true fuel cost by load, compare it to recovery, and spot where contracts and invoicing are leaving money behind. The conversation covers fuel indexes, actual consumption, idling, miles, invoicing and how a TMS can help carriers react […]

top_signals.title: Autonomous Trucking in 28 States: What Changes Next?
top_signals.summary:
Autonomous trucks are already operating in 28 states—and that changes how freight leaders should think about the market right now. uShip CEO Sean Wu breaks down what autonomy could mean for consolidation, where standardization wins, and why bulky, nonstandard freight still needs human coordination. He also explains where marketplaces fit, why oddball freight gets pushed […]

top_signals.title: Bitmine nears 5% of Ethereum supply after buying 28,086 ETH
top_signals.summary: Bitmine bought 28,086 ETH, boosting its treasury to 5.93 million tokens worth $14.8 billion and representing 4.9% of Ethereum’s total supply.
